About

The Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum is a lightweight, water-based formulation created to support thicker, fuller, and healthier-looking lashes and brows. 

Designed for use twice daily, this serum features a blend of 11 key ingredients, including four peptide complexes and plant extracts, to nourish and support the visible density of lashes and brows. 

With consistent use, visible improvements in volume and overall appearance can typically be seen in as little as four weeks.

This formula contains SYMPEPTIDE XLASH® complex (with Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17), Anargy® complex (with Oligopeptide-2 and Glycoproteins), Widelash™ complex (with Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1 and Panthenol), REDENSYL™ complex (with Larix Europaea Wood Extract, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, and Zinc Chloride), CAPIXYL™ complex (Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 and Trifolium Pratense Flower Extract), and High-Solubility Caffeine.

All trademarks belong to their respective owners. Usage Details

How to Use

Read full Usage directions

How to Use

  • After cleansing and drying the application area, apply a thin layer along the lash line and eyebrows in the morning and evening. 
  • If irritation occurs, rinse off, cease use, and consult a physician. 
  • Use only as directed on unbroken skin. 
  • Patch testing prior to use is advised. 
  • Keep out of reach of children.

Product & Safety Guidance

Read full product & safety Guidance

Product & Safety Guidance

  • Apply a small amount of the product onto a clean area of skin on the upper forearm.

  • Keep the area dry.

  • If the product has a specified duration of use, rinse off after this time has elapsed. Otherwise rinse off after 24 hours.

  • If any redness, burning, itching, blistering or irritation is observed at any time throughout the test, do not use the product.

Recycling Instructions

Recycling Instructions

Before Recycling:

Empty the contents of the container. Remove cap, lid, dropper, pump, and other components and rinse the bottle/jar with water.

Packaging items with adhesive-based labels:

Contact your local recycling facility to ensure recyclability via curbside recycling program.
Otherwise, dispose via our in-store recycling program.

Serum/Oil, Shampoo, Conditioner, Shower Gel, Lotion, Hand Soap Bottles:

#1 PETE & #2 HDPE and glass bottles are recyclable through the majority of local curbside recycling programs.
# 5 PP bottles are usually recyclable through local curbside recycling programs. Please contact your local recycling facility to ensure recyclability.
Otherwise, dispose via our in-store recycling program.

Dropper Lids:

Dispose of via our in-store recycling program.

Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum FAQs

What does Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum do for lashes and brows?

We formulated our Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum to enhance the look of lashes and brows by promoting denser, fuller, and thicker-looking hair. This formulation features a complex blend of peptides, plant extracts, and other active ingredients that support the look of hair density.

Does Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum formulation contain prostaglandins?

No, Multi-peptide Lash and Brow Serum does not contain prostaglandins. Instead, it uses a complex blend of peptides, extracts, and other active ingredients to promote denser, fuller, and thicker-looking hair.

How often should I use Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum?

For best results, apply the Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum twice—in your AM and PM routines. Use on clean, dry skin, applying a thin layer to the lash line and brow area.

How long does it take to see results with Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum?

Visible improvements in lash and brow volume and fullness can typically be seen after 4 weeks of consistent use. We recommend using this formulation over an extended period to maintain noticeable results.

Is Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum safe for sensitive eyes?

The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum is ideal for all skin types. However, if you have particularly sensitive eyes or skin, we recommend doing a patch test before full application.

Can Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum be used with other lash and brow products?

Yes, you can layer our Multi-Peptide Lash and Brow Serum alongside other lash and brow products, such as mascaras or brow gels. However, we recommend ensuring the serum has fully absorbed into the skin before applying other products, to maximize its effectiveness.
